programme.title: Prosta sprawa
programme.desc: W Kotlinie Jeleniogórskiej pojawia się tajemniczy bezimienny mężczyzna (Mateusz Damięcki), który ma za sobą trudną przeszłość. Chce spłacić dług przyjacielowi, który przed laty bezinteresownie mu pomógł. Przekonuje się jednak, że teraz to Prosty wpadł w poważne kłopoty. Jego mieszkanie jest zdemolowane, a on sam zniknął wraz z ciężko chorą córką. Okazuje się, że okradł lokalną mafię, którą rządzi Kazik (Piotr Adamczyk), by zdobyć pieniądze na leczenie dziewczynki. Przybysz próbuje odnaleźć go, zanim zrobią to gangsterzy. Jest gotów podjąć największe nawet ryzyko i stawić czoła lokalnemu półświatkowi, byle tylko ocalić człowieka, któremu tak wiele zawdzięcza. Na podstawie powieści Wojciecha Chmielarza.

programme.title: Wiarołom
programme.desc: Ania (Julia Szczepańska) po latach nieobecności wraca do rodzinnej wsi. Chce zaopiekować się ciężko chorą matką Marą (Małgorzata Hajewska-Krzysztofik) i spędzić z nią ostatnie miesiące. Przekonuje się, że niewiele się tu zmieniło. Dziewczyna spotyka Alka (Mateusz Więcławek), z którym kiedyś łączyła ją młodzieńcza miłość. Uruchamia to lawinę niespodziewanych zdarzeń i stawia Marę wobec najtrudniejszego wyzwania w życiu. Zarówno bowiem umierająca kobieta, jak i ojcowie młodych, biznemsmen Francisz (Jacek Koman) oraz zniszczony życiem Więźko (Mirosław Zbrojewicz) skrywają tajemnicę, która od lat jest dla nich ogromnym ciężarem. Teraz ich historie wychodzą na światło dzienne. Wspomnienia mieszają się z teraźniejszniejszością, a rzeczywistość z omamami i wizjami. Oniryczne, pełne metafor i zagadek kino to pełnometrażowy debiut Piotra Złotorowicza.

programme.title: Algorytm miłości
programme.desc: Grupa atrakcyjnych singli bierze udział w telewizyjnym show "Algorytm miłości". Program miał być kręcony w słonecznej Hiszpanii, ale wskutek wielu zawirowań ekipa musi pracować w podwarszawskiej "Willi Amora". Uczestnicy liczą na sławę, a przy tym walczą o spore pieniądze. Ich losami będzie kierowała zaawansowana sztuczna inteligencja - Algorytm Miłości Optymalizujący Relacje. Przez cały program A.M.O.R będzie oceniał kompatybilność par i ich szanse na zbudowanie związku. Już niedługo cała ekipa przekona się, z jakimi wyzwaniami przyjdzie im się zmierzyć. Parodia popularnych programów rozrywkowych.

programme.title: Eksperyment: Odsiadka 2
programme.desc: Tym razem za kraty aresztu śledczego w Bartoszycach trafią kobiety. Wyzwanie podjęły Urszula Dudziak, Roxie Węgiel, Julia von Stein, Danuta Martyniuk, Marta Linkiewicz i Katarzyna "Kasix" Paciorek. Przyzwyczajone do luksusów i błysków fleszy celebrytki zmierzą się z twardą więzienną rzeczywistością. Będzie to dla nich prawdziwy test charakteru. Zasady zostały zmodyfikowane i dostosowane do dynamiki nowej grupy. Uczestniczki eksperymentu przekonają się, jak silny jest kobiecy instynkt przetrwania.

programme.title: Ikona mody
programme.desc: Trwa Paryski Tydzień Mody. Prestiżowe wydarzenia przyciąga ludzi z całego świata. Wśród gorączkowych przygotowań i blasku fleszy splatają się losy trzech kobiet. Ceniona amerykańska reżyserka Maxine Walker (Angelina Jolie) ma nakręcić film na zlecenie jednego z domów mody. W lawinie pokazów, przymiarek i poszukiwania efektownych ujęć nagle musi się zatrzymać - dowiaduje się, że zdiagnozowano u niej nowotwór. W jej filmowych projekcie uczestniczy modelka z Sudanu Południowego, Ada (Anyier Anei), która uciekła od koszmaru wojny. Próbuje zrealizować marzenia w kuszącym, ale też bezlitosnym świecie wielkich pieniędzy i głośnych marek. Nie jest pewna, czy wybrała dobrą drogę. Na drugim planie pełnego blichtru świata pracuje utalentowana makijażystka Angele (Ella Rumpf), która pragnie spełnić swoje pisarskie ambicje i wyjść z cienia. Reżyserka Alice Winocour ciekawe kobiece portrety stworzyła też w filmach "Proxima" i "Pamiętać Paryż.

programme.title: Dziki
programme.desc: Karpaty, XVII wiek. Półdziki, niemy wojownik (Tomasz Włosok) stracił rodziców w bandyckiej zasadzce. Matka zdążyła ukryć go na górskim szlaku. Dorastał wśród nieujarzmionej przyrody i drapieżnych zwierząt, ucząc się przetrwać w każdych warunkach. Gdy trafia pod opiekę Macieja (Leszek Lichota), uczestnika wielu wojen, nagrodzonego przez króla majątkiem i tytułem szlacheckim, musi nauczyć się życia wśród ludzi. Niezwykłego chłopca doglądać ma guślarka i znachorka Vesna (Agata Buzek). Z czasem Dziki gromadzi wokół siebie wiernych kompanów, którzy dla niego są gotowi na wszystko. Skorzy do bójek i występków awanturnicy w końcu przekraczają granicę, kradnąc jednemu ze szlachciców konia. Muszą porzucić dotychczasowe życie i uciec w niedostępne góry. Wokół bandy banitów unosi się aura wolności, ale słyną też jako mściciele i obrońcy uciśnionych. Równie silna jak lojalność wobec przyjaciół jest miłość Dzikiego do córki Macieja, Antoniny (Angelika Włoch). Prawdziwe piekło rozpętuje się, gdy na drodze młodego wojownika staje okrutny cesarski inkwizytor, psychopatyczny Łowca z Carcassone (Sebastian Fabijański). Przybywa on w Karpaty z zadaniem odzyskania papieskich insygniów skradzionych przez zbójników. Misja to tylko pretekst, by urządzić krwawe łowy. Schwytanie Dzikiego i jego towarzyszy staje się dla dostojnika obsesją. Pierwszy polski film nakręcony z myślą o ekranach IMAX, przy użyciu kamery ARRI ALEXA 65, dającej spektakularną głębię obrazu i wyjątkową plastyczność detali. Za zdjęcia odpowiada Bartek Cierlica, który z Maciejem Kawulskim współpracował już przy hitach "Akademia Pana Kleksa" czy "Jak zostałem gangsterem. Historia prawdziwa".

programme.title: Włatcy móch
programme.desc: Opowieść o grupie ośmiolatków z klasy II B. Każdy z chłopców jest zupełnie inny. Konieczko to typ intelektualisty, który swoją przyszłość wiąże z karierą naukową. Maślana sens życia widzi w posiadaniu, a pieniądze zamierza zdobywać wszelkimi możliwymi sposobami. Anusiak jest synem działacza związkowego i kieruje się prostymi zasadami. Czesio został szczególnie doświadczony przez los. Umarł i teraz powrócił jako zombi. To co łączy tak odmienne osobowości to chęć objęcia władzy nad światem. Każdy ma inny pomysł na to jak ją zdobyć. Na drodze do spełnienia swoich marzeń bohaterowie napotykają na rozmaite przeszkody. Ich głównym źródłem są dorośli. Najwięcej kłopotów sprawia im nauczycielka, pani Frał. Jest starą panną i chciałaby, żeby wszystkie dzieci były grzeczne, ładne i uśmiechnięte. W szkole chłopcy mają sprzymierzeńca w osobie szkolnej higienistki. Ta bardzo nieszczęśliwa wdowa kocha wszystkie dzieci na świecie.

programme.title: Miasto długów
programme.desc: Próbując zapomnieć o tragicznych wydarzeniach poprzedniego wieczoru, windykatorzy rzucają się w wir pracy. Nadia, Murek i Buźka wraz ze swoimi bliskimi starają się uratować fundację, która zajmuje się pomocą bezdomnym na Pradze. Tymczasem policyjne śledztwo dotyczące zniknięcia Mateusza i wydarzeń na barce przynosi więcej pytań niż odpowiedzi. Nie wiadomo już, kto jest wrogiem, a kto przyjacielem. Windykatorzy zdają sobie sprawę, że Sławkowi grozi niebezpieczeństwo i starają się nie dopuścić do kolejnego nieszczęścia.

programme.title: Strach się bać! - Outlast
programme.desc: Agata Pachole oraz Ola Tarnowska zagwarantują dreszczyk emocji. Wcielą się w dziennikarza śledczego chcącego odkryć mroczny sekret szpitala psychiatrycznego Mount Massive.

programme.title: Strach się bać! - Outlast 2
programme.desc: Kontynuacja jednego z najlepszych horrorów ostatnich lat. Gracz zmierzy się z Sullivanem Knothem i jego zwolennikami jako Blake Langermann. Dziennikarz bada zagadkę śmierci ciężarnej Jane.

programme.title: Poszukiwacze historii
programme.desc: Jakiś czas temu poszukiwaczom udało się odnaleźć w Chrostkowie właz i wieżę niemieckiego czołgu Panzerkampfwagen V Panther należącego do 7. Dywizji Pancernej, nazywanej też Dywizją Duchów. Przez kilka miesięcy twórcy programu starali się o pozwolenia na dalsze poszukiwania. Wykrywacz ramowy i georadar podpowiadają, że w okolicy można znaleźć również inne elementy czołgu. Punkt wskazywany przez urządzenia leży na drodze powiatowej, co oznacza, że pozostałości po pojeździe muszą się znajdować ok. dwa metry pod asfaltem.

programme.title: Poszukiwacze historii
programme.desc: Olaf Popkiewicz oraz Radosław Biczak podejmują się nowych wyzwań. W tej odsłonie programu wykopią z ziemi kolejne zapomniane skarby związane z ważnymi wydarzeniami historycznymi.

programme.title: Informe Plus+. Laurie Cunningham. Un estilo diferente
programme.desc: Laurie Cunningham llegó al Real Madrid como el fichaje más caro de su historia a finales de los 70. Tenía un talento y unas condiciones físicas excepcionales, pero un pisotón quebró un dedo de su pie y también su carrera. Cunningham, que creció en Londres dentro de una familia de inmigrantes jamaicanos, fue uno de los primeros jugadores negros que destacó en Inglaterra, donde se enfrentó a un racismo descarnado. Esta es la poco conocida historia de un apasionado de la moda y el baile, de una leyenda del Rayo Vallecano, que terminó su vida en un accidente de tráfico del que se cumplieron 35 años en julio pasado.

programme.title: The Usual Suspects
programme.desc: "The greatest trick the devil ever pulled was convincing the world he didn't exist," says con man Kint, drawing a comparison to the most enigmatic criminal of all time, Keyser Söze. Kint attempts to convince the feds that the mythic crime lord not only exists, but is also responsible for drawing Kint and his four partners into a multi-million dollar heist that ended with an explosion in San Pedro Harbor - leaving few survivors.

programme.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
programme.desc: Will Rodman, a scientist in San Francisco, is experimenting with a drug that he hopes will cure his father's Alzheimer's disease. After his work is deemed a failure, Will becomes the guardian of Caesar, an infant chimp who was exposed in utero to Will's drug. Caesar displays unusual intelligence, and Will decides to continue his experiments secretly. But as Caesar's intellect and abilities grow, he comes to represent a threat to man's dominion over Earth.

programme.title: Trance
programme.desc: Simon (James McAvoy), a fine-art auctioneer, joins a gang of thieves led by Franck (Vincent Cassel) to steal a priceless Goya painting. During the heist Simon suffers a head injury and awakes with no memory of where he hid the artwork. When torture and physical threats fail to break through his amnesia, Franck hires a hypnotherapist named Elizabeth (Rosario Dawson) to find the answer. But as Elizabeth probes the recesses of Simon's mind, the lines between truth and deceit start to blur.

programme.title: The Whistlers
programme.desc: A Romanian police officer, determined to free from prison a crooked businessman who knows where a mobster's money is hidden, must learn the difficult ancestral language used on the island of Gomera.

programme.title: Kingdom of the Planet of the Apes
programme.desc: Many years after the reign of Caesar, a young ape goes on a journey that will lead him to question everything he's been taught about the past and make choices that will define a future for apes and humans alike.

programme.title: The Shape of Water
programme.desc: Elisa is a mute, isolated woman who works in a hidden, high-security government laboratory. Her life changes forever when she discovers the lab's classified secret -- a mysterious, scaled creature from South America that lives in a water tank.

programme.title: Body at Brighton Rock
programme.desc: Wendy, a part-time summer employee at a mountainous state park, takes on a rough trail assignment at the end of the season, trying to prove to her friends that she's capable enough to do the job. When she takes a wrong turn and ends up deep in the backcountry, she stumbles upon what might be a potential crime scene. Stuck with no communication after losing her radio and with orders to guard the site, Wendy must fight the urge to run and do the harder job of staying put.

programme.title: L'aube de la planète des singes
programme.desc: Une nation de plus en plus nombreuse de singes évolués, dirigée par César, est menacée par un groupe d'humains qui a survécu au virus dévastateur qui s'est répandu dix ans plus tôt. Ils parviennent à une trêve fragile, mais de courte durée : les deux camps sont sur le point de se livrer une guerre qui décidera de l'espèce dominante sur terre.

programme.title: La guerre de la planète des singes
programme.desc: Les singes menés par César cherchent la paix après la mort de Koba, mais lorsqu'un méchant colonel décide de perpétrer un massacre auprès des primates, César sait qu'il faut se battre contre cet homme et son armée. Cette bataille déterminera le destin de la planète.

programme.title: Bienvenue à Gattaca
programme.desc: Dans un futur proche, la science a vaincu les secrets de la génétique. On peut, dès la conception d'un enfant, le protéger de toute maladie et orienter sa vie. Gattaca est un centre d'études pour les meilleurs de ces jeunes au patrimoine génétique impeccable. Là, ils sont formés et conçoivent d'ambitieux programmes spatiaux.

programme.title: Olympische Spiele

August in der französischen Hauptstadt und in den Herzen der rund 10.000 Athlet:innen, die dort erwartet werden. Die Athletinnen und Athleten treten in 32 Sportarten, 45 Disziplinen und 329 Wettkämpfen an. Eurosport überträgt alle Wettkämpfe, ARD und ZDF berichten im Wechsel und zeigen ausgewählte Wettkämpfe. Prédateurs et proies, un équilibre fragile
programme.desc: Regard scientifique sur la façon dont les guépards chassent les gazelles et autres proies rapides, offrant de nouvelles perspectives sur la façon dont ces prédateurs utilisent leur vitesse et leur agilité.

programme.title: Confessions d'un arnaqueur
programme.desc: Surnommé le Mini Madoff, Kiener est l'un des arnaqueurs les plus réputés d'Allemagne, qui a dupé des milliers d'investisseurs privés et de banques, notamment Barclays et JP Morgan, pour la coquette somme de plus de 300 millions de dollars.

programme.title: Toujours plus vite: l'odyssée des transports
programme.desc: Le transport aérien, l'un des plus utilisés, connaîtra une expansion considérable dans un avenir proche; des dizaines de milliards de passagers se déplacent déjà chaque année et il va falloir imaginer de nouveaux concepts.

programme.title: La chaîne: l'odyssée des objets
programme.desc: Lors des World Food Championships, un hamburger à 5 $ révèle un immense réseau mondial de serres visibles depuis l'espace, d'élevages bovins et de ketchup historique.

programme.title: Comment ça marche?
programme.desc: Comment construire un port prêt à accueillir les plus grands navires porte-conteneurs, produire 28 millions de sacs plastiques et souffler le verre pour en faire des décorations ?

programme.title: Comment ça marche?
programme.desc: Alors que le monde moderne devient de plus en plus automatisé et mécanisé, il est facile de se détacher de la façon dont les choses sont fabriquées et fonctionnent. On vous fait découvrir les miracles de l'ingénierie qui sous-tendent la vie au 21e siècle. Les choses apparemment banales sont souvent le résultat de processus d'ingénierie et de production très sophistiqués.

programme.title: Sauver Venise
programme.desc: Venise résiste aux dangers qui l'entourent depuis plus de 1 500 ans; elle semble flotter sur les eaux.

programme.title: Dezoom, les plaies de notre terre
programme.desc: On pose un nouveau regard sur notre planète avec des images tournées avec un drone.

programme.title: Moteur de recherche
programme.desc: On décrypte le monde pour vous! Venez satisfaire votre curiosité en explorant avec nous des sujets aussi divers que la consommation, la santé, l'environnement, les sciences et les nouvelles technologies.

programme.title: Surbooké
programme.desc: Que se passe-t-il lorsqu'une destination dépasse sa capacité de charge ; on découvre comment l'industrie arrivera à composer avec ces milliards de touristes qui devraient bientôt s'ajouter à tous ceux qui inondent déjà tous ces circuits.

programme.title: Déchiffrer les villes
programme.desc: Séoul est devenue une puissance économique et culturelle en dépit de la menace nord-coréenne. Lieu de vie de 10 millions de personnes, elle évolue au rythme de son désir de performance.

programme.title: La semaine verte
programme.desc: L'engouement pour les protéines et son impact sur les producteurs laitiers. L'agriculture en Ukraine en 2026. Les derniers pêcheurs d'esturgeons noirs. Et la richesse insoupçonnée des boisés de ferme.

programme.title: Qu'est-ce qui se passe quand...?
programme.desc: Sébastien tente d'affronter sa peur des hauteurs; il rencontre un neuropsychologue qui lui apprend à mieux contrôler sa peur, et discute avec l'aventurière Mylène Paquette qui lui explique comment elle a réussi à surmonter sa peur des requins.

programme.title: Qu'est-ce qui se passe quand...?
programme.desc: Sébastien se demande ce qui se passe dans son corps quand il arrête de manger; il pratique le jeûne intermittent, pendant 16 heures tous les jours.

programme.title: Bulletin spatial
programme.desc: Avec Isabelle Tremblay de l'Agence spatiale canadienne, l'astronaute David St-Jacques et Félix Lajeunesse, du Studio Felix & Paul, Pierre-Yves demande si ce serait possible d'habiter un jour l'espace.

programme.title: Bulletin spatial
programme.desc: Grâce aux diverses missions du nouveau millénaire, on élargit aujourd'hui le champ de connaissances en quête des grands secrets de l'univers ; on vit possiblement la période la plus passionnante de l'étude spatiale depuis 40 ans.

programme.title: Ghostbusters II
programme.desc: After saving New York City from a ghost attack, the Ghostbusters -- a team of spirit exterminators -- is disbanded for demolishing parts of the city during the battle. But when Ghostbuster Peter Venkman learns that spirits have taken an interest in his son, the men launch a rogue ghost-chasing mission. The quest quickly goes awry, landing them in court. But when the ghosts turn on the judge, he issues an order allowing the Ghostbusters to get back to work.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
programme.desc: Thrilled by his experience with the Avengers, young Peter Parker returns home to live with his Aunt May. Under the watchful eye of mentor Tony Stark, Parker starts to embrace his newfound identity as Spider-Man. He also tries to return to his normal daily routine -- distracted by thoughts of proving himself to be more than just a friendly neighborhood superhero. Peter must soon put his powers to the test when the evil Vulture emerges to threaten everything that he holds dear.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
programme.desc: Peter Parker's relaxing European vacation takes an unexpected turn when Nick Fury shows up in his hotel room to recruit him for a mission. The world is in danger as four massive elemental creatures -- each representing Earth, air, water and fire -- emerge from a hole torn in the universe. Parker soon finds himself donning the Spider-Man suit to help Fury and fellow superhero Mysterio stop the evil entities from wreaking havoc across the continent.

programme.title: The Mummy
programme.desc: Nick Morton is a soldier of fortune who plunders ancient sites for timeless artifacts and sells them to the highest bidder. When Nick and his partner come under attack in the Middle East, the ensuing battle accidentally unearths Ahmanet, a betrayed Egyptian princess who was entombed under the desert for thousands of years. With her powers constantly evolving, Morton must now stop the resurrected monster as she embarks on a furious rampage through the streets of London.

programme.title: The Last Duel
programme.desc: Jean de Carrouges is a respected knight known for his bravery and skill on the battlefield. Jacques Le Gris is a squire whose intelligence and eloquence makes him one of the most admired nobles in court. When Le Gris viciously assaults Carrouges' wife, she steps forward to accuse her attacker, an act of bravery and defiance that puts her life in jeopardy. The ensuing trial by combat, a grueling duel to the death, places the fate of all three in God's hands.

programme.title: Freud's Last Session
programme.desc: On the eve of World War II, Sigmund Freud and C.S. Lewis gather to discuss the existence of God and the future of mankind.

programme.title: Tolkien
programme.desc: As a young student, J.R.R. Tolkien finds love, friendship and artistic inspiration among a group of fellow outcasts. Their brotherhood soon strengthens as Tolkien weathers the storm of a tumultuous courtship with Edith Bratt and the outbreak of World War I. These early life experiences later inspire the budding author to write the classic fantasy novels "The Hobbit" and "The Lord of the Rings."

programme.title: The Song of Bernadette
programme.desc: Based on the popular novel by Franz Werfel, this drama focuses on Bernadette Soubirous (Jennifer Jones), a young French woman who experiences vivid visions of the Virgin Mary. While many dismiss her claims, certain people, including the priest Dominique Peyramale (Charles Bickford), slowly begin to believe her. Eventually, Bernadette is deemed a saint, and becomes a nun at a convent, where she must deal with jealousy from others who resent her revered status.

programme.title: The Ghost and Mrs. Muir
programme.desc: Defying her conventional in-laws, young widow Lucy Muir (Gene Tierney) leaves London with her young daughter and moves away for a quieter life in a secluded seaside cottage. Lucy discovers the ghost of the deceased former owner, sea captain Daniel Gregg (Rex Harrison), is haunting the house, but gathers the courage to stand up to him, and woman and ghost become friends. Faced with dwindling means of support, Lucy agrees to the Captain's challenge to write his colorful life story.

programme.title: Nightmare Alley
programme.desc: Roustabout Stanton Carlisle joins a traveling carny and unsuccessfully schemes to figure out the mind-reading act of Mademoiselle Zeena and her alcoholic husband, Pete. But when Pete dies, Zeena is forced to take on Stanton as a partner, and he quickly proves more gifted than his predecessor. Ambitious to a fault, Carlisle abandons Zeena and the carny to reinvent himself as The Great Stanton, wowing high-class audiences in a Chicago hotel.

programme.title: Chicago Fire
programme.desc: Deputy Commissioner Boden returns to Firehouse 51 to investigate a disastrous firefight and the surrounding mystery that left one of their own in peril.

programme.title: Chicago P.D.

programme.title: Slo Pitch
programme.desc: As Captain of the slo pitch beer league team, the Brovaries, Joanne is determined to make this season count, but the team just can't get their act together. Joanne's hot lawyer fiancé is so bad that kicking her off the team is the only solution. Stoner-bisexual Ann is sleeping with TWO members of the Brovaries' biggest rival team, and disgraced ex pro player Mel has sunk into a deep depression. If all that wasn't enough, German beer hound Boris needs to find a wife or face imminent deportation before playoffs, and rookie Lee spends more time with her glove on her head making Tik Tok videos than catching anything. The Brovaries need to come together if they're going to make it past the drama, save a marriage, fake a marriage, and beat their rival team, The Blue Gays. There may not be any money, trophies or sponsorship deals up for grabs, but for the Brovaries, slo pitch is life or death. Well, maybe for Joanne anyway. Everyone else is just in it for the beer. And the girls.

programme.title: Histoires de filles
programme.desc: Coco campe un personnage pour séduire une intello ; Judith reprend contact avec une vieille amie avec laquelle elle s'était disputée.

programme.title: La chute du faucon noir
programme.desc: En 1992, Mohamed Farrah Aidid fait régner la terreur sur le territoire somalien. Pour venir en aide à la population qui meurt de faim, George Bush, alors président des États-Unis, met sur pied une expédition humanitaire. Quelques mois plus tard, Bill Clinton est au pouvoir, et poursuit l'oeuvre de son prédécesseur.

programme.title: Les Boys
programme.desc: À Cuba, Stan et ses trois copains se trouvent enfin face à l'arnaqueur; la mort est au rendez-vous; pourront-ils survivre et revenir à temps pour disputer leur match de balle-molle?

programme.title: Tranches de vie
programme.desc: L'aventure prendra une foule de significations dans la vie des couples de la série.

programme.title: En temps
programme.desc: Dans un futur où le temps vaut de l'argent et les riches sont immortels, Will Salas est un pauvre homme à qui il ne reste plus qu'un jour à vivre. Lorsqu'il sauve Henry Hamilton, on lui donne un siècle de vie. Cependant, cela attire l'attention des autorités. Accusé à tort de meurtre, Will doit fuir et emporte avec lui la fille d'un homme très riche.

programme.title: Léo
programme.desc: Léo conteste la croissance de Paul et son percentile après un rendez-vous médical; inquiet, Léo développe soudainement des plaques dans le dos, il décide alors de tout faire pour aider le petit Paul à grandir et se développer plus vite.

programme.title: Boomerang
programme.desc: C'est le grand jour. Alors que Stéphanie, Monique et Sylvie répètent pour le mariage, Patrick angoisse et Karine doit se dépêcher de partir de New York pour arriver à temps pour la cérémonie.

programme.title: V
programme.desc: John, le visiteur-espion, tente toujours de faire un enfant à Robin dans le but de produire un autre super-enfant comme Diana; Willie, du groupe de la résistance, se fait tirer en tentant d'amasser de l'information d'un chroniqueur visiteur; entre-temps, Kyle soupçonne que son père soit toujours vivant lorsqu'elle le voit parler à la télévision en pleine santé, même si celui-ci a subi des blessures dévastatrices.

programme.title: Fort Boyard
programme.desc: Invités : Sonia Vachon et Francis DePassillé et les concurrents Claude Carrier, Sylvia Tremblay et Alain Brisson; parmi les épreuves : Francis De Passillé (porteur d'eau et pont de singe); Sonia Vachon (souris et menottes).

programme.title: Psych: enquêteur malgré lui
programme.desc: Shawn emmène Gus, pour son anniversaire, à la soirée de promotion de la nouvelle collection de la griffe Ciao ; au cours de la soirée, le couturier meurt électrocuté.

programme.title: Ma sorcière bien-aimée

programme.title: La petite maison dans la prairie

programme.title: Panhandle
programme.desc: John Sands (Rod Cameron), a reformed outlaw living in a small Mexican town, learns that his brother has been killed in the Texas Panhandle, and he sets out to investigate. When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner. He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown.

programme.title: Little Big Horn
programme.desc: Captain Phillip Donlin (Lloyd Bridges) and his small troop must rush to reach Little Big Horn in order to warn General Custer of the Sioux attack that awaits him. As they race against time, and Donlin pushes them hard through an arduous and dangerous journey, the Sioux start taking out the soldiers one at a time. Meanwhile, Donlin also clashes with Lt. John Haywood (John Ireland), who Donlin knows is having an affair with his wife, Celie (Marie Windsor).

programme.title: The Cowboy and the Indians
programme.desc: Rancher Gene Autry tries to aid neighboring Navajos suffering from malnutrition, but he is opposed by a crafty and crooked trading post proprietor.

programme.title: Texas Terror
programme.desc: Just before Bess (Lucile Browne) returns home to the ranch owned by her father, Dan Matthews, robbers attack him and his friend, Sheriff John Higgins (John Wayne) -- and Dan is killed in the gunfight. Convinced that one of his shots resulted in Dan's death, John resigns as sheriff. Former sheriff Ed Williams (George Hayes) convinces John to work for Bess to make up for his error, and he becomes her foreman. John doesn't confide his involvement in her father's death, but Bess soon hears rumors.

programme.title: Tumbleweed Trail
programme.desc: Scheming to steal Bill Ryan's (Kermit Maynard) cattle to pay a debt, his half-brother, Brad Barton (Bob Duncan), has his men shoot the rancher. With Bill left for dead, Brad and corrupt lawyer Alton Small (Ted Adams) produce a forged will that disinherits Bill's teenage daughter, Robin (Shirley Patterson), and son Freckles (Johnny McGovern). Aid arrives in the form of cowboys Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), who help Robin fight for her rightful property.

programme.title: SIGN OFF
programme.desc: Sign off.

programme.title: Under California Stars
programme.desc: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers. Taking pity on Ted, a young man who was disabled in a riding accident, Roy offers him a job on the ranch. But Ted's stepfather, Lige, leads a gang of thieves posing as wild-horse wranglers, and their prime target is Roy's famous horse, Trigger, which they kidnap for ransom.

programme.title: Overland Riders
programme.desc: Cowboy Fuzzy (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) is riding in a stagecoach with young Jean (Patti McCarty), on his way to a business deal with her father. The coach is attacked by bandits, but luckily Fuzzy's buddy Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) is in the vicinity, and he comes to the rescue, fending off the outlaws. Billy helps Jean get back home, only to learn that the bandits he's just thwarted have killed her father and pinned the crime on Fuzzy. Billy then must go after the real murderers.

programme.title: Prairie Rustlers
programme.desc: In a small town, the sheriff is murdered, and Deputy Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), a diner owner by day, must take over the slain lawman's responsibilities. The leader of the cattle rustlers who killed the sheriff is named Jim (Buster Crabbe), and he bears a striking resemblance to Fuzzy's friend Billy (Buster Crabbe), much to the deputy's confusion. Billy comes to town, and, to help Fuzzy and vanquish the rustlers, he must face Jim, his cousin, who still holds a grudge against him.

programme.title: Wild Country
programme.desc: Bandit Rip Caxton (I. Stanford Jolley) escapes from prison, and U.S. Marshal Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and sidekick Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) track him to a small town. There, Caxton kills a sheriff, and, with the help of crooked local saloon boss Clark Varney (Douglas Fowley), installs a conspirator in the dead lawman's place. Meanwhile, Eddie comes across Martha Devery (Peggy Wynn), the distressed daughter of the former sheriff, and promises her he will bring the villains to justice.

programme.title: Little Big Horn
programme.desc: Captain Phillip Donlin (Lloyd Bridges) and his small troop must rush to reach Little Big Horn in order to warn General Custer of the Sioux attack that awaits him. John Haywood (John Ireland), who Donlin knows is having an affair with his wife, Celie (Marie Windsor).

programme.title: The Young Savages
programme.desc: After a Puerto Rican teen is murdered by three white adolescents, the case comes to Assistant District Attorney Hank Bell (Burt Lancaster). Realizing that he used to date the mother (Shelley Winters) of one of the suspects, he wonders if the boy is his son. Despite Bell's personal involvement, the district attorney (Edward Andrews) keeps him on the case. However, as Bell discovers street gang involvement in the case, he and his wife (Dina Merrill) begin to face physical threats.

programme.title: Witness to Murder
programme.desc: From her window, Cheryl Draper (Barbara Stanwyck) sees a neighbor, Albert Richter (George Sanders), murder a young woman. When Cheryl goes to the police, they cannot find any evidence because Richter has hidden the body. Cheryl persists in her claims without evidence, leading concerned policeman Larry Mathews (Gary Merrill) to worry that she is becoming obsessed. After Richter becomes aware of Cheryl's accusations, he conspires to make it appear that she is insane.

programme.title: The Killer Is Loose
programme.desc: Humble bank teller Leon Poole (Wendell Corey) participates in a heist that doesn't go as planned. When police surround his apartment, there's a shoot-out, during which Detective Sam Wagner (Joseph Cotten) unwittingly kills Poole's wife. Poole is subsequently captured and jailed, but three years later he's back out on the street and hell-bent on revenge. Wanting the punishment to fit the crime, he vows that he won't kill Wagner -- just his wife (Rhonda Fleming).

programme.title: The Large Rope
programme.desc: An innocent ex-con becomes a two-time loser when he finds himself the scapegoat in the murder of a disreputable female.

programme.title: Three Bad Sisters
programme.desc: Following the death of a wealthy man, his three daughters squabble about who should be the principal heiress.

programme.title: A Hole in the Head
programme.desc: Based on Arnold Schulman's Broadway play of the same name, this comedy finds widower Tony Manetta (Frank Sinatra) struggling to own and operate a Miami hotel. Irresponsible in both business and romance, Tony is dedicated to his young son, Ally (Eddie Hodges), though he butts heads with his own brother, Mario (Edward G. Robinson). When Mario agrees to help Tony out financially, the catch is that the bachelor has to settle down and find a mother for his son.

programme.title: The Purple Plain
programme.desc: At the end of World War II in Burma, Canadian Royal Air Force pilot Forrester (Gregory Peck) is a loner whose bravery can't cover a streak of reckless instability. When his actions cause an injury, he is nearly transferred, but Dr. Harris (Bernard Lee) recommends pulling him from duty, due to the emotional trauma he's suffered. Forrester then accompanies Harris to a Christian missionary outpost, where he meets Anna (Win Min Than) and begins to find interest in living again.

programme.title: Three in the Attic
programme.desc: A campus swinger (Christopher Jones) keeps three girlfriends in the dark; they catch on and try to exhaust him.

programme.title: The Honey Pot
programme.desc: As an elaborate joke, the wealthy Cecil Fox (Rex Harrison) hires actor William McFly (Cliff Robertson) to play his personal assistant and invites three of his old flames, including Texan socialite Mrs. Lone-Star Crockett Sheridan (Susan Hayward), to visit him. Claiming to be on his deathbed, Fox has motives that remain unclear, and things take a surprising turn when one of the guests is found dead. As Inspector Rizzi (Adolfo Celi) investigates the crime, the plot of the mystery thickens.

programme.title: Confidence Girl
programme.desc: A young woman's inherent honesty leads to the downfall of her conniving boyfriend's scams.

programme.title: The Girl in Black Stockings
programme.desc: Residents at a posh Utah hotel become suspects when a girl is found murdered during a pool party. Local sheriff Jess Holmes (John Dehner) takes charge of the investigation and must discover who among the terrified guests and staff -- including bodacious vixen Harriet Ames (Mamie Van Doren), the hotel's bitter, crippled proprietor (Ron Randell), visiting lawyer David Hewson (Lex Barker) and his secretary, Beth (Anne Bancroft) -- is the culprit, even as murders continue to take place.

programme.title: The Wild Party
programme.desc: Embittered ex-NFL pro Tom Kupfen (Anthony Quinn) has taken to hanging with a group of go-nowhere beatniks, including good-schoolgirl-gone-bad Honey (Kathryn Grant), hopped-up jazz musician Kicks Johnson (Nehemiah Persoff) and ticking time bomb Gage Freeposter (Jay Robinson). Together they drink, dabble in drugs and commit just enough petty thefts to support their lurid lifestyle. But when a con they try to pull on a couple of squares goes sour, the hip crooks get in way over their heads.

programme.title: Killer's Kiss
programme.desc: Davey Gordon (Jamie Smith), a New York City boxer aging out of his profession, meets dancer Gloria Price (Irene Kane), and they begin a romance. However, their budding relationship is interrupted by Gloria's violent boss, Vincent Rapallo (Frank Silvera), who has eyes for his employee. The two decide to skip town, but before they can, Vincent and his thugs abduct Gloria, and Davey is forced to search for her among the most squalid corners of the city, with his enemy hiding in the shadows.

programme.title: A Kiss Before Dying
programme.desc: Amoral Bud Corliss (Robert Wagner) pursues young heiress Dorie Kingship (Joanne Woodward) in the hopes of getting his hands on the fortune amassed by her father (George Macready). But after Dorie succumbs to Bud's charms and becomes pregnant as a result, he fears she'll be cut off by the family and murders her in a fashion that makes it look as if the poor girl committed suicide. When Bud tries to cozy up with Dorie's grieving sister, Ellen (Virginia Leith), she begins to suspect his intentions.

programme.title: The Captive City
programme.desc: A private investigator informs small-town newspaper editor Jim Austin of corrupt local activity. When the investigator is killed, Austin believes it's an act of revenge, and his own detective work reveals a network of gambling and corruption. Crime boss Murray Sirak controls the whole town, including the police. Sirak answers to his own boss, "Mr. Big," who is seemingly untouchable, but Austin risks his life to expose the truth.

programme.title: Cloudburst
programme.desc: Canadian World War II veteran John Graham (Robert Preston) works in London as a code breaker. Tragedy strikes when his pregnant wife, Carol (Elizabeth Sellars), is accidentally run over by two crooks who are speeding away from the scene of a murder. Haunted, grieving and thirsting for revenge, Graham sets out to find the two fugitive murderers. When he does, he intends to kill them, the same way they killed Carol. But will that assuage his grief?

programme.title: The Boss
programme.desc: Coming home at the end of World War I, Matt Brady (John Payne), the black-sheep brother of big-city political boss Tim Brady (Roy Roberts), is a loose cannon who gets into drunken fights and impulsively marries a total stranger, the plain but kind-hearted Lorry (Gloria McGhee). Taking over his brother's political machine after Tim's sudden death, Matt becomes powerful and extremely wealthy, but his corrupt dealings with a local gangster (Robin Morse) threaten to destroy everything he has.

programme.title: The Devil's 8
programme.desc: A federal agent (Christopher George) trains escaped chain-gang convicts for a mission to bust a Southern moonshine racket.

programme.title: Operation Kid Brother
programme.desc: Sean's brother plays a hypnotic plastic surgeon (Neil Connery), pressed into service as a James Bond-type spy.

programme.title: Anna Lucasta
programme.desc: Anna Lucasta has been walking the streets in San Diego since being thrown out of home, at 19, by her alcoholic father, Joe. She's estranged from her family, but when her father and brother-in-law see greedy potential in an arranged marriage to affluent Rudolph, Anna is called back home. Old wounds have hardly healed, though. Just as Anna starts to feel for Rudolph, Danny, an old friend, returns to make life difficult.

programme.title: Visit to a Chief's Son
programme.desc: When a Western anthropologist, Robert (Richard Mulligan), brings his son, Kevin (John Philip Hogdon), to Kenya to document an eclipse and a remote Masai tribe's reaction to it, both father and son are in for a serious case of culture shock. Used to Western comforts, Kevin is at first hesitant and uncomfortable among the natives, but the English-speaking son of the tribe's chief, Nemolok (Johnny Sekka), helps familiarize Kevin with his culture, opening his eyes to a new way of life.

programme.title: The Kitchen Toto
programme.desc: In the 1950s Kenya, a preacher (Nathan Dambuza Mdledle) speaks out against the Mau Mau terrorists and is killed for it, leaving his young son, Mwangi (Edwin Mahinda), to fend for himself. Mwangi goes to work in the kitchen of the local British police chief, John Graham (Bob Peck), who welcomes him -- though his wife (Phyllis Logan) and son (Ronald Pirie) treat Mwangi with contempt. Things worsen when the Mau Mau intercede in his life again, this time demanding that Mwangi ally himself with them.

programme.title: Black Girl
programme.desc: The 17-year-old dreamer Billie Jean is the youngest in a family of loving yet discouraging women. Billie Jean's mother, Mama Rosie, cares deeply about her three biological children. However, her own personal disappointments have left her embittered, and she only offers encouragement to her adopted daughter, Netta. When Netta, a successful teacher, returns to visit the family, she may be the voice of guidance and hope Billie Jean desperately needs.

programme.title: Halls of Anger
programme.desc: The court-ordered desegregation of an inner-city Los Angeles high school brings 60 white students into the predominantly African-American student body. African-American teacher Quincy Davis (Calvin Lockhart) reaches out to all his students, enticing Lerone (DeWayne Jessie) to advance his reading skills with racy paperbacks, protecting new student Douglas (Jeff Bridges) after a race-motivated beating and trying to quell a potential student strike led by the militant J.T. (James A. Watson Jr.).

programme.desc: L'équipe poursuit un tueur en série dont le nom figure sur la liste officielle des personnes les plus recherchées par le FBI; le dénouement de l'enquête et la course folle du meurtrier prennent une tournure surprenante.

programme.title: FBI
programme.desc: Un braquage dans une clinique communautaire tourne au drame; l'équipe enquête alors sur un réseau de trafiquants de drogue et découvre que le médecin de la clinique pourrait être plus impliqué que tout le monde le croyait; pendant ce temps, un problème familial crée un froid entre Isobel et sa belle-fille.

programme.title: CIA
programme.desc: Colin et son équipe reçoivent une information concernant un attentat imminent; ils en viennent à retrouver un jeune homme kidnappé il y a neuf ans, en Turquie; pour tenter de déjouer l'attentat, ils doivent enquêter, dans les moindres détails, sur ces neuf années dans la vie du jeune homme; pendant ce temps, Bill s'intéresse de très près à une personne proche de Colin.

programme.title: FBI: International
programme.desc: L'équipe est appelée à enquêter lorsqu'une étudiante américaine est arrêtée dans une auberge de Prague pour avoir fait preuve d'agressivité à l'égard de la police locale, qui n'a pas tenu compte de ses accusations d'abus sexuel.

programme.title: MacGyver
programme.desc: Mac est placé dans une fausse cellule de prison; son objectif: gagner la confiance du Marchand, l'un des meilleurs agents de CODEX, afin d'obtenir des informations sur leur prochain coup.

programme.title: Élémentaire
programme.desc: Les choses bougent au sein de l'équipe quand le détective Bell reçoit une offre d'emploi alléchante qui le pousse à envisager de quitter le département ; Holmes et Watson sont embauchés pour enquêter sur la disparition d'une jeune femme.

programme.title: Liaison fatale
programme.desc: Les proches de Dan sont bouleversés de le voir réapparaître dans leur vie après toutes ces années en prison ; dans le passé, Dan réalise qu'Alex désire quelque chose de plus sérieux ; malgré la passion qui les unit, ce n'est pas ce qu'il veut, lui.

programme.title: Détectives privés
programme.desc: Alors que Shade et Angie s'adaptent à leurs nouveaux rôles en tant que partenaires à parts égales, la propriétaire d'une équipe de course automobile les embauche afin d'enquêter sur des menaces adressées à son entreprise et à son pilote.

programme.title: La famille fait loi
programme.desc: Abigail et Daniel représentent un couple atteint de la trisomie 21 qui doit prouver aux autorités qu'il est apte à élever son enfant, qui doit bientôt voir le jour.

programme.desc: DiNozzo fait équipe avec sa petite amie quand les preuves montrent que l'arme du crime utilisée dans une affaire du NCIS a été achetée pour une opération d'infiltration.

programme.desc: Frank est abasourdi par une manoeuvre du maire, qui a osé contourner son autorité pour demander directement que Jamie soit responsable de son service de sécurité ; pendant ce temps, Danny et Baez enquêtent sur le meurtre d'un riche étudiant.

programme.title: Republic of Doyle
programme.desc: Jake searches for evidence to prove his innocence; Leslie makes a decision that may compromise her job; Mal and Rose question Doyle's return.

programme.title: Republic of Doyle
programme.desc: Jake must solve a puzzling case; Ned Bishop jeopardizes an important day; Leslie's past actions come back to haunt her.

programme.title: Republic of Doyle
programme.desc: The Doyles work with Jimmy and Wolf to protect a witness; Jake and Saul face off again; Rose discovers something about Sloan's past; Jake gets shocking news.

programme.title: Ballistic
programme.desc: Beck, a homeless veteran, learns his sister's killer is free after early prison release, sparking his quest for revenge.

programme.title: Dexter: Resurrection
programme.desc: Dexter embeds himself in New York's ride-share community to track down a serial killer; Harrison spirals from the guilt of a violent outburst.

programme.title: Apocalypse Now Redux
programme.desc: Secret ops assassin Captain Willard (Martin Sheen) is sent on a mission up a river during the Vietnam War to "terminate with extreme prejudice" the errant Colonel Kurtz (Marlon Brando). In addition to being re-edited with the new footage, the film has been completely restored, converted to digital, and reprinted by dye-transfer, improving color reproduction.

programme.title: Universal Soldier
programme.desc: During the Vietnam War, soldier Luc Deveraux (Jean-Claude Van Damme) finds that his superior officer, Andrew Scott (Dolph Lundgren), has turned violently deranged, and the two fight to the death. After their bodies are retrieved, they are placed into a secret program in which they are reanimated and trained to become unquestioning killing machines. While Deveraux and Scott initially have no memory of their former lives, glimpses of their pasts start to return, rekindling their intense conflict.

programme.title: Horrible Bosses
programme.desc: Nick (Jason Bateman), Dale (Charlie Day) and Kurt (Jason Sudeikis) are workers who would like nothing better than to grind their oppressive employers into the dirt. Quitting their jobs is not an option, so -- fueled by alcohol and dubious advice from a criminal (Jamie Foxx) -- the men devise a complex and seemingly foolproof plan to permanently rid themselves of their terrible bosses. The problem is, any plan is only as clever as the brains behind it.

programme.title: The Guilt Trip
programme.desc: Before embarking on a once-in-a-lifetime road trip, Andy Brewster pays a visit to his overbearing mother, Joyce. That proves to be a big mistake; Andy caves in under pressure to take his mom along for the ride. Early on -- as the miles roll by -- Andy feels nothing but aggravation at her antics. Eventually however, he comes to realize that they have more in common than he first thought and that Joyce's wisdom might be just what he needs.

programme.title: Snoopy, Come Home
programme.desc: Charlie Brown's (Chad Webber) beloved dog Snoopy (Bill Melendez) receives a letter from his original owner, Lila (Johanna Baer), who has been sick in the hospital. With his bird friend Woodstock, Snoopy goes to visit Lila, making his way across the country despite seeing "no dogs allowed" signs everywhere. When Lila gets better, she asks Snoopy to live with her. After a farewell party, he sets out to live with Lila, leaving Charlie Brown depressed.

programme.title: JFK Revisited: Through the Looking Glass
programme.desc: Filmmaker Oliver Stone examines the circumstances surrounding the assassination of President John F. Kennedy on Nov. 22, 1963, in Dallas.

programme.title: She's Out of My League
programme.desc: Kirk (Jay Baruchel), an average guy stuck in a dead-end job, can't believe his luck when a gorgeous, successful woman named Molly (Alice Eve) falls in love with him. With no help from his stunned friends, relatives and ex-girlfriend, Kirk must figure out how to make this unlikely relationship work, even though he's the first to admit that Molly is way beyond him.

programme.title: Don Jon
programme.desc: New Jersey bartender Jon Martello knows what's important: his friends, his family, his car, his church, his sexual conquests -- and porn. In fact, Jon is a porn addict and has never had a genuine relationship with a woman. However, when he meets Barbara he has to change his operating methods, because Barbara won't be bedded easily. For the first time in his life, Jon begins a real courtship, but his obsession with erotica threatens to ruin everything.

programme.title: It Gets Worse
programme.desc: Newly evicted best friends Ethan, Abi and Sam escape reality with one last unforgettable night out at a London gay club; but when long-buried tensions surface, the trio must confront whether their friendship can survive the fallout.

programme.title: It Gets Worse
programme.desc: Abi has it all: a flat with her boyfriend, a new promotion, a more adult life; but beneath the surface, cracks are beginning to show; the trio reunite at a dinner party, which forces Abi to look closer at her seemingly perfect life.

programme.title: Shell
programme.desc: Desperate to reclaim her career, once-beloved actress Samantha Lake gets drawn into the glamorous world of wellness mogul Zoe Shannon, only to uncover a monstrous truth beneath the seemingly flawless surface.

programme.title: Noah
programme.desc: When God decides that mankind has become too sinful and must be wiped off the Earth, he chooses Noah (Russell Crowe), a pious man, for a great task. Noah must build an ark large enough to hold his wife (Jennifer Connelly), adopted daughter (Emma Watson), sons (Logan Lerman, Douglas Booth, Leo McHugh Carroll) and their wives -- plus breeding pairs of every animal. When the task is completed, Noah and his family witness God's wrath in the form of an apocalyptic flood.

programme.title: The King's Speech
programme.desc: England's Prince Albert must ascend the throne as King George VI, but he has a speech impediment. Knowing that the country needs her husband to be able to communicate effectively, Elizabeth hires Lionel Logue, an Australian actor and speech therapist, to help him overcome his stammer. An extraordinary friendship develops between the two men, as Logue uses unconventional means to teach the monarch how to speak with confidence.

programme.title: Nine
programme.desc: Italian film director Guido Contini (Daniel Day-Lewis) grapples with epic crises in his personal and professional lives. At the same time, he must strike a balance of the demands of numerous women in his life, including his wife (Marion Cotillard), his mistress (Penélope Cruz), and his confidant (Judi Dench).

programme.title: Sahara
programme.desc: Seasoned adventurer Dirk Pitt (Matthew McConaughey) sets out for the African desert with his sarcastic companion (Steve Zahn) in search of a ship rumored to have vanished long ago, the main draw being the treasure supposedly hidden within the lost vessel. When the daring duo come across a beautiful scientist (Penélope Cruz) who is juggling an escape from a warlord and a mission to stop the spread of a powerful plague, their desert expedition begins to heat up.

programme.title: Argo
programme.desc: On Nov. 4, 1979, militants storm the U.S. embassy in Tehran, Iran, taking 66 American hostages. Amid the chaos, six Americans manage to slip away and find refuge with the Canadian ambassador. Knowing that it's just a matter of time before the refugees are found and likely executed, the U.S. government calls on extractor Tony Mendez (Ben Affleck) to rescue them. Mendez's plan is to pose as a Hollywood producer scouting locations in Iran and train the refugees to act as his "film" crew.

programme.title: Killer Joe
programme.desc: A cop (Matthew McConaughey) who moonlights as a hit man agrees to kill the hated mother of a desperate drug dealer (Emile Hirsch) in exchange for a tumble with the young man's virginal sister (Juno Temple).

programme.title: Piranha
programme.desc: Spring break turns gory when an underground tremor releases hundreds of prehistoric, carnivorous fish into Lake Victoria, a popular waterside resort. Local cop Julie Forester (Elisabeth Shue) must join forces with a band of unlikely strangers -- though they are badly outnumbered -- to destroy the ravenous creatures before everyone becomes fish food.

programme.title: Jackass Presents: Bad Grandpa
programme.desc: Irascible Irving Zisman and his young and impressionable grandson, Billy, set out on a road trip across America. Hidden cameras capture their insane and shocking encounters with a diverse set of unsuspecting citizens, including male strippers, disgruntled contestants (and their mothers) from a children's beauty pageant, mourners at a funeral home, patrons at a biker bar and more. Based on the "Jackass" TV series.

programme.title: Fight or Flight
programme.desc: A mercenary takes on the job of tracking a high-value asset known only as "The Ghost" on an international flight. Realizing the plane is filled with assassins assigned to kill them both, the pair must work together in a fight for their lives.

programme.title: Heist 88
programme.desc: A criminal mastermind decides to pull one last job before going to prison and recruits a group of young bank employees to steal millions in a daring and brazen assault on the U.S. banking system.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity
programme.desc: Soon after moving into a suburban tract home, Katie (Katie Featherston) and Micah (Micah Sloat) become increasingly disturbed by what appears to be a supernatural presence. Hoping to capture evidence of it on film, they set up video cameras in the house but are not prepared for the terrifying events that follow.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity 2
programme.desc: When the Reys move into their new Southern California home, little do they realize that the house is already occupied. After coming home one day to find the house in disarray -- but with no signs of forced entry or robbery -- they install a video surveillance system to catch the perpetrators. But nothing prepares them for what happens next.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity 3
programme.desc: A videographer becomes obsessed with finding the source of disturbing late-night noises in his home and discovers its terrifying origin.

programme.title: The Lego Movie
programme.desc: An ordinary LEGO figurine Emmet who always follows the rules, is mistakenly identified as an extraordinary being and the key to saving the world. He finds himself drafted into a fellowship of strangers who are on a mission to stop an evil tyrant's plans to conquer the world. Unfortunately for Emmet, he is hopelessly and hilariously unprepared for such a task, but he'll give it his all nonetheless.

programme.title: Jimmy Neutron: Boy Genius
programme.desc: Jimmy Neutron: Boy Genius tells the simple story of a 10-year-old boy and his robot dog - battling evil, rescuing his parents, saving the Earth - and returning home in time for dinner. Jimmy's always inventing gadgets to make his life in Retroville more interesting. A boy genius with real kid emotions, Jimmy sometimes fantasizes about life on his own. But when the parents of Jimmy's hometown are kidnapped by invading aliens, he quickly discovers that things aren't so great when they're gone.

programme.title: Walking Out
programme.desc: When a city teen travels to Montana to go hunting with his estranged father, the trip becomes a battle for survival when they encounter a grizzly bear.

programme.title: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
programme.desc: Capt. James Kirk (William Shatner) and the crew of the USS Enterprise are carrying Klingon Chancellor Gorkon (David Warner) to Earth to negotiate a peace treaty with the United Federation of Planets. The ship appears to fire on a Klingon vessel, and Gorkon is killed in the subsequent confusion. Kirk and the ship's doctor, Leonard McCoy (DeForest Kelley), are arrested for murder, leaving Spock (Leonard Nimoy) to figure out who is behind the attack and save the negotiations.

programme.title: Star Trek: Nemesis
programme.desc: Capt. Jean-Luc Picard (Patrick Stewart) diverts the starship Enterprise from its scheduled trip to Cmdr. Riker (Jonathan Frakes) and Counselor Troi's (Marina Sirtis) wedding to negotiate a peace treaty with the Romulans. Picard is shocked when Shinzon (Tom Hardy), the new Praetor of the Romulans, admits to being a clone of him. When the crew members discover a break-in on their computer, they are forced into a life-or-death battle to stop Shinzon's Warbird before it can destroy the Earth.

programme.title: Bran Nue Dae
programme.desc: A rebellious young man runs away from home but returns after experiencing an amazing journey.

programme.title: Yours, Mine & Ours
programme.desc: When Coast Guard Adm. Frank Beardsley (Dennis Quaid) decides to move his family of eight children back to his old hometown, he encounters handbag designer Helen North (Rene Russo), an old flame from high school. Immediately, sparks fly between the two, and marriage is proposed. But Frank isn't the only one with kids to worry about -- Helen has a total of 10. Right away, the children have no intention of playing nicely, and together they decide to sabotage their parents' relationship.

programme.title: Show Dogs
programme.desc: After a failed attempt to recover a stolen baby panda, police dog Max reluctantly teams up with a human FBI agent named Frank. A hot tip leads Max and Frank to Las Vegas for the world's most exclusive dog show. To find the panda, Max goes undercover as a contestant to get the lowdown from his fellow canines. With help from their new friends, the crime-fighting duo must now foil another kidnapping plot and rescue other valuable animals from a gang of greedy smugglers.

programme.title: A Boy Named Charlie Brown
programme.desc: When Charlie Brown (Peter Robbins) enters the school spelling bee, the perpetually crabby Lucy (Pamelyn Ferdin) predicts his humiliation. But with the help of his best friend, Linus (Glenn Gilger), and faithful dog, Snoopy (Bill Melendez), Charlie Brown not only wins the spelling bee, he's chosen to attend the national spelling bee in New York City, leading to many misadventures in the big city. This is the first animated feature based on Charles Schulz's comic strip, "Peanuts."

programme.title: Magic Mike
programme.desc: By day, Mike (Channing Tatum) makes ends meet any way he can -- handyman jobs, detailing cars or designing furniture. But nighttime is when Mike really gets to display his many talents: He's the hot headliner in an all-male revue. Mike sees potential in a 19-year-old he dubs the Kid (Alex Pettyfer), takes the teen under his wing and instructs him in the tricks of the trade. However, Mike learns there's a downside to the stripper lifestyle when it threatens his romance with the Kid's sister.

programme.title: Magic Mike XXL
programme.desc: It's been three years since Mike Lane's (Channing Tatum) retirement from stripping, but the former dancer misses the excitement and feeling of being on stage. Most of all, though, he misses the best friends that he ever had, the crew known as the Kings of Tampa. Opportunity comes knocking when the guys look him up as they travel to Myrtle Beach, S.C., for a stripper convention. With the promise of outrageous fun, a reinvigorated Mike can't resist the chance to join in and take it off again.

programme.title: Super
programme.desc: After his wife (Liv Tyler) leaves him, a fry cook (Rainn Wilson) emulates a TV superhero and transforms himself into a costumed vigilante.

programme.title: 4:44 Last Day on Earth
programme.desc: Two lovers (Willem Dafoe, Shanyn Leigh) immerse themselves in sex, art and other activities after word breaks that the world will end by the next morning.

programme.title: Life During Wartime
programme.desc: Nothing comes easily for Joy (Shirley Henderson) and her sisters, Trish (Allison Janney) and Helen (Ally Sheedy). Joy, unhappy with her job and her sleazy husband (Michael Kenneth Williams), is haunted by her dead boyfriend's ghost (Paul Reubens). Trish's pedophile husband (Ciarán Hinds) is behind bars, and she's ready to move on with her life. As an increasingly bitter Helen approaches middle age with a failing screenwriting career, it becomes clear her mother offers little comfort.

programme.title: Freedom's Path
programme.desc: When Union soldier William runs from battle, he's taken to safety by a heroic young Black man. Kitch is part of a secret community of freed slaves running a section of the Underground Railroad, but a desperate slave catcher is on their trail.

programme.title: Not Without Hope
programme.desc: Four friends face disaster when their boat capsizes in the Gulf of Mexico. Battling massive waves, sharks, dehydration and hypothermia, they cling to hope as Capt. Timothy Close and his Coast Guard crew launch a daring rescue through a raging storm to save them.

programme.title: Failure to Launch
programme.desc: A young man (Matthew McConaughey) continues to live at the home of parents who, in desperation to push him out of the nest once and for all, hatch a plan. They hire a beautiful woman (Sarah Jessica Parker) to entice him to assume the mantle of responsibility and get his own place.

programme.title: Nobody's Fool
programme.desc: After serving five years in prison, wild child Tanya looks to her buttoned-up, by-the-book sister Danica to help her get back on her feet. The feisty ex-con becomes suspicious and concerned when Danica tells her that she's in a long-distance, online relationship with a mysterious man she's never seen. As the polar opposites start to collide, Tanya soon discovers that her sibling's picture-perfect life may not be what it seems.

programme.title: Failure to Launch
programme.desc: A young man (Matthew McConaughey) continues to live at the home of parents who, in desperation to push him out of the nest once and for all, hatch a plan. They hire a beautiful woman (Sarah Jessica Parker) to entice him to assume the mantle of responsibility and get his own place.

programme.title: The First Wives Club
programme.desc: Despondent over the marriage of her ex-husband to a younger woman, a middle-aged divorcée plunges to her death from her penthouse. At the woman's funeral, her former college friends (Bette Midler, Goldie Hawn, Diane Keaton) reunite for the first time in nearly 30 years. When the three discover the reason for their friend's suicide, they realize that all of their ex-husbands have taken them for granted -- and deciding it's time for revenge, they make a pact to get back at their exes.

programme.title: Top Gun
programme.desc: The Top Gun Naval Fighter Weapons School is where the best of the best train to refine their elite flying skills. When hotshot fighter pilot Maverick (Tom Cruise) is sent to the school, his reckless attitude and cocky demeanor put him at odds with the other pilots, especially the cool and collected Iceman (Val Kilmer). But Maverick isn't only competing to be the top fighter pilot, he's also fighting for the attention of his beautiful flight instructor, Charlotte Blackwood (Kelly McGillis).

programme.title: Rambo III
programme.desc: Reluctant one-man army Rambo goes into action against Soviet invaders in Afghanistan. Sought out in a Buddhist monastery retreat, Rambo declines his former commander's request for help to deliver missiles to the mujahideen, but when his superior is captured and imprisoned, the hulking hero brings out the big guns.

programme.title: Behind Enemy Lines
programme.desc: A Navy pilot (Owen Wilson) is shot down over enemy territory, and struggles to survive the relentless pursuit of a ruthless secret police enforcer, a deadly tracker, and countless hostile troops. With time running out, the injured pilot's commanding officer (Gene Hackman) goes against orders to carry out a desperate rescue mission.

programme.title: Homestead
programme.desc: A former green beret and other survivors take refuge inside an elaborate compound when an attack on America leaves the world in chaos.

programme.title: I Was a Stranger
programme.desc: Tragedy strikes a Syrian family in Aleppo, starting a chain reaction of events involving five different families in four different countries.

programme.title: Gravity
programme.desc: Dr. Ryan Stone is a medical engineer on her first shuttle mission. Her commander is veteran astronaut Matt Kowalski, helming his last flight before retirement. Then, during a routine space walk by the pair, disaster strikes: The shuttle is destroyed, leaving Ryan and Matt stranded in deep space with no link to Earth and no hope of rescue. As fear turns to panic, they realize that the only way home may be to venture further into space.

programme.title: Red Eye
programme.desc: In the wake of her grandmother's funeral, hotel manager Lisa Reisert is waiting to fly back home when she meets charming Jackson Rippner at check-in. She thinks it luck that they're seated together on the plane, but soon learns otherwise. Jackson hopes to assassinate the head of Homeland Security, but to do so, he needs Lisa to reassign the official's room number at her hotel. As insurance, Jackson has kidnapped Lisa's father.

programme.title: Lara Croft: Tomb Raider
programme.desc: This live action feature is inspired by the most successful interactive video-game character in history -- Lara Croft. Beautiful and brainy, Lara is the heroine of Eidos Interactive's phenomenally successful "Tomb Raider" game series. It is one woman's fearless quest crisscrossing the globe, in an amazing attempt to save the world.

programme.title: Lara Croft Tomb Raider: The Cradle of Life
programme.desc: Fearless explorer Lara Croft (Angelina Jolie) tries to locate Pandora's box before criminals Jonathan Reiss (Ciarán Hinds) and Chen Lo (Simon Yam) use it for evil. According to myth, the box holds deadly organisms that could kill millions of people. With her old partner, Terry (Gerard Butler), Croft goes on a hunt that takes her from Europe to Asia to Africa, where pal Kosa (Djimon Hounsou) helps her. Along the way, Croft rappels down cliffs, scuba dives and decimates many male opponents.

programme.title: The Ruins
programme.desc: Amy (Jena Malone), Stacy (Laura Ramsey), Jeff (Jonathan Tucker) and Eric (Shawn Ashmore) look for fun during a sunny holiday in Mexico, but they get much more than that after visiting an archaeological dig in the jungle. Carnivorous vines try to ensnare the friends in their tendrils, forcing the group to fight for survival.

programme.title: The Mexican
programme.desc: Brad Pitt stars as Jerry Welbach, a reluctant bagman, who has been given two ultimatums: The first is from his mob boss to travel to Mexico and retrieve a priceless antique pistol, known as "the Mexican"... or suffer the consequences. The second is from his girlfriend Samantha (Julia Roberts) to end his association with the mob. Jerry figures alive and in trouble with Samantha is better than the more permanent alternative, so he heads south of the border.

programme.title: Regarding Henry
programme.desc: An unscrupulous corporate lawyer, Henry Turner (Harrison Ford) will do whatever it takes to win a case, and treats his family with the same degree of ruthlessness. After Henry gets caught in the middle of a robbery and is shot in the head, he wakes from a coma to find that he has amnesia and can't even remember how to do the simplest of tasks. As he recovers and relearns how to function, Henry reveals a much kinder and more thoughtful personality, much to the surprise of his family and friends.

programme.title: Shenandoah
programme.desc: American Civil War film about a wealthy widower who has remained steadfast in his opposition to the war on moral grounds. However, he is forced to become involved in the conflict when his son-in-law is called upon to serve in the Confederate forces, his youngest son is captured by the Union army, and another son and his pregnant daughter-in-law are killed by looters.

programme.title: The War Wagon
programme.desc: An ex-convict and his partner eye an armored stagecoach full of gold fitted with a Gatling gun for protection.

programme.title: Santa Fe Trail
programme.desc: After graduating from West Point, Jeb Stuart and George Custer are both stationed at Fort Leavenworth in Kansas. Once there, they find that the violent abolitionist John Brown has laid waste to the state, killing anyone who gets in the way of his anti-slavery crusade. While the duo must work together to battle the murderous revolutionary, they also come to blows over their competing love for Kit Carson Holliday.

Sydney and Gail, as well as fellow survivors Deputy Dewey (David Arquette) and Randy (Jamie Kennedy) have to find out who is behind this new murder spree, before they all end up dead.

programme.title: Scream 3
programme.desc: In the final installment of this trilogy, a murder spree begins to happen again; this time targeted toward the original Woodsboro survivors and those associated with the movie-inside-a-movie, Stab 3. Sydney must face the demons of her past to stop the killer.

programme.title: Scream 4
programme.desc: It has been many years since the Ghostface Killer cut a deadly path through the town of Woodsboro. In order to get over the trauma of those horrific events, Sidney Prescott (Neve Campbell) has written a self-help book. She returns to Woodsboro for her book tour, and reconnects with old friends Gale Weathers (Courteney Cox) and Sheriff Dewey (David Arquette). However, Sidney's arrival also sparks the return of Ghostface, putting Sidney and everyone she loves in danger.

programme.title: Erotic Alien Encounter

programme.title: The Faculty

Controlled by otherworldly parasites, the faculty try to infect students one by one. Cheerleader Delilah (Jordana Brewster), football player Stan (Shawn Hatosy), drug dealer Zeke (Josh Hartnett) and new girl Marybeth (Laura Harris) team up with some of their other classmates to fight back against the invaders.

programme.title: The Contractor

programme.title: The Perfect Gamble

programme.title: The Core
programme.desc: Geophysicist Dr. Josh Keyes discovers that an unknown force has caused the Earth's inner core to stop rotating. To resolve the crisis, Keyes, along with a team of the world's most gifted scientists, travel into the Earth's core. Their mission: detonate a device that will reactivate the core.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: This long-running animated comedy focuses on the eponymous family in the town of Springfield in an unnamed U.S. state. The head of the Simpson family, Homer, is not a typical family man. A nuclear-plant employee, he does his best to lead his family but often finds that they are leading him. The family includes loving, blue-haired matriarch Marge, troublemaking son Bart, overachieving daughter Lisa and baby Maggie. Other Springfield residents include the family's religious neighbor, Ned Flanders, family physician Dr. Hibbert, Moe the bartender and police chief Clancy Wiggum.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: For young Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naive Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son. For 12 years on "The Big Bang Theory," audiences came to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. In "Young Sheldon," audiences get a chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. Jim Parsons, who plays the adult version of Sheldon on "The Big Bang Theory," narrates.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Al final de la década de los ochentas, en el negocio ilícito más lucrativo de la época, "el oro blanco", las rutas de las Bahamas y Florida, ya no son tan viables para el transporte de la cocaína; la persecución de los miembros de los carteles colombianos y su guerra entre ellos mismos se intensifica, generando que estos bandidos sean extraditados, encarcelados en su país o asesinados. Algunos son condenados al encierro voluntario, escondidos en algún rincón para evitar su captura, por cuenta de las fuerzas armadas o de sus enemigos. El negocio cambia y es cuando aparece Amado Carrillo Fuentes "El Señor de los Cielos" que en forma muy discreta se dedica al transporte del producto que proveen los narcotraficantes colombianos restantes, convirtiéndose en el narcotraficante más poderoso de los cuatro carteles que operan en México: el de Juárez, el del Golfo, el de Sinaloa y el de Tijuana. Su historia se devela en este drama cargado de acción y giros inusitados.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Al final de la década de los ochentas, en el negocio ilícito más lucrativo de la época, "el oro blanco", las rutas de las Bahamas y Florida, ya no son tan viables para el transporte de la cocaína; la persecución de los miembros de los carteles colombianos y su guerra entre ellos mismos se intensifica, generando que estos bandidos sean extraditados, encarcelados en su país o asesinados. Algunos son condenados al encierro voluntario, escondidos en algún rincón para evitar su captura, por cuenta de las fuerzas armadas o de sus enemigos. El negocio cambia y es cuando aparece Amado Carrillo Fuentes "El Señor de los Cielos" que en forma muy discreta se dedica al transporte del producto que proveen los narcotraficantes colombianos restantes, convirtiéndose en el narcotraficante más poderoso de los cuatro carteles que operan en México: el de Juárez, el del Golfo, el de Sinaloa y el de Tijuana. Su historia se devela en este drama cargado de acción y giros inusitados.

programme.desc: Stories can be told from a rain puddle or a pile of snow, but only a forensic meteorologist has the ability to look at these and help solve murders. "Storm of Suspicion" highlights crime and weather and how these two can be intertwined. Elements -- like dew drops or even the temperature -- can be the key to unlocking more clues to solve crimes. The cases that are featured are bone-chilling and almost unbelievable. In some cases, it is seen where a rain puddle can preserve DNA, or a snow pile can feature footprints. Dr. Elizabeth Austin, a forensic meteorologist who has worked on countless cases in which weather and crime go hand in hand plays a part in the series.

programme.title: Wheeler Dealers France

Le duo se lance dans sa restauration en remplaçant les freins par des freins à disques notamment, ou encore en le dotant d'un allumage électronique.

Gerry et Aurélien décide de s'attaquer à ce bijou, mais non sans quelques problèmes, puisque le modèle qu'ils acquièrent dans une casse pour 5200 euros doit subir de nombreuses réparations s'ils espèrent le revendre à des collectionneurs.

programme.title: Champions League Weekly
programme.desc: Les dernières actualités, résultats et critiques des matchs de Ligue des Champions, avec des interviews d'experts et de stars du football, condensées en images.

programme.title: Back 2 Back - Paris dans la légende
programme.desc: Ce soir-là, au bout du suspense et de 120 minutes indécises, le Paris-SG de Luis Enrique est entré dans la légende. Une deuxième victoire consécutive en finale de Ligue des Champions qui propulse le club parisien dans une autre dimension. De la Puskas Arena au Parc des Princes, en passant par la Géorgie sur les traces de Kvaratskhelia, l’Espagne dans la ville d’Enrique, le Portugal chez João Neves, le Brésil avec l’ancien attaquant de Paris Lucas Moura, les rues de Budapest en compagnie de la famille Zaïre-Emery… les caméras de Canal+ vous font revivre l’histoire de ce " Back 2 back " de façon inédite !

programme.title: Histoire de Champions
programme.desc: L'international français Robert Pirès a disputé 82 matchs et inscrit 14 buts en Ligue des champions, au cours de sa carrière, marquant les esprits notamment avec l'OM et Arsenal. C'est avec les Gunners d'Arsène Wenger que Pirès vit l'essentiel de son parcours européen, devenant un maestro du milieu de terrain et cumulant 63 matchs pour 11 buts dans la compétition sous e maillot londonien.

programme.title: Late Football Club
programme.desc: Suivez toute l'actualité foot du jour, avec le prisme des infos de la rédaction de Canal+, des infos transferts, des reportages, des interviews. Autour de la table, les journalistes et consultants de Canal+ livrent leur regard sans concession.

programme.title: Jour de foot
programme.desc: Analyse des rencontres. Tour des stades avec les envoyés spéciaux de CANAL+ pour découvrir ce qui s'est passé et recueillir les toutes premières réactions des acteurs.

programme.title: Histoire de Champions
programme.desc: Retour sur les plus beaux matchs de l'histoire de la Ligue des Champions, avec les exploits des clubs français, l'OL de Juninho, les premiers pas du jeune Mbappé avec l'AS Monaco, l'OM qui renverse Dortmund ou encore le PSG plus que jamais proche du Graal. Mais aussi des soirées sur les plus grands clubs de la compétition, sur les plus grandes stars ou encore des soirées thématiques.

programme.desc: Focus sur la rencontre qui oppose les surprenants et imprévisibles Norvégiens de Bodo/Glimt aux Dogues lillois.

programme.title: Paroles de président
programme.desc: Avoir un chien et pratiquer une activité sportive en même temps, c'est possible ! Et notamment grâce à la Fédération Française des Sports et Loisirs Canins, qui propose de nombreuses disciplines se pratiquant en binôme avec son animal : canicross, canimarche, cani-VTT, ou encore ski-joëring. Et du côté compétition, la France, spécialiste de l'exercice, n'est pas en reste, et espère même accueillir les championnats du monde en 2028.

programme.title: Paroles de président
programme.desc: Créée il y a dix ans, la Fondation Alice Milliat a énormément oeuvré en faveur des femmes dans le sport, que ce soit pour l'accès au sport, la médiatisation, ou encore la représentation dans les instances. Mais elle a également réhabilité Alice Milliat, pionnière du droit des femmes dans l'écosystème sportif. Mais la tâche est malheureusement loin d'être terminée.

programme.desc: Alors que le parcours 2027 du Tour de France Femmes avec Zwift vient d'être dévoilé, Mejdaline Mhiri et ses invitées reviennent sur l'évolution du cyclisme féminin ses dernières années : la domination de FDJ United-Suez et Demi Vollering, l'évolution des équipes, du sponsoring et de la médiatisation, ou encore l'impact de Pauline Ferrand-Prévot, vainqueure du Tour en 2025.
